This fixture is invented for regression testing. It does not contain private
application text.

## Proposal Text

Our preliminary data show that prototype sensors remain stable over 10,000
loading cycles in a bench-top test. The measurement variance is small enough to
support Aim 1 feasibility, although the field deployment conditions still need
